SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. S. S. File No.
Station,
Date Sept., 20, 1932

Subject (in full) Breach of Municipal Regulations
in re. social under S. 5.

Made by D. I. Campbell. Forwarded by Insp C. Bishop

Sir,
In reference attached, I beg to state as the result of an inspection of premises, 410 Sinza Road, this a.m., Sept., 20 it was found that the signboard had been completely removed.

Your obedient servant,
D. I. Campbell.
D. I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

上海公共租界
C. S. S. 档案号
分局，
日期 1932年9月20日

事由（全称） 关于S. 5条款下的社交活动违反市政规章事宜。

由 D. I. Campbell 呈报。经督察 C. Bishop 转呈

先生，
关于附件所述事项，谨此陈述，今晨（9月20日）对新闸路410号房屋进行检查后，发现招牌已被完全拆除。

您顺从的仆人，
D. I. Campbell.
副督察。

（印：... 1932年9月20日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Special Branch S. L. Station,
REPORT
Date September 19 32.
(in full) Breach of Municipal Regulations
in re "Loh Sik Kyi", S. E.
Made by.................... Forwarded by.................... C.D.I. Prince.

Sir,
On September 17, 1932, I called the attention of Loh Sik
Kyi (陸爵) attached to Special Branch S. L, to the complaint
against him as quoted in the attached report made by S.I. J. Powell,
Vigus Station, regarding his noncompliance with instructions
regarding a sunshade at his premises No. 415 Sinez Road. . Loh
Sik Kyi informed me that the sunshade in question had not been
used since the first complaint regarding it was made, and he
could not understand what further was required. I then
pointed out to him that the supports of the sunshade constituted
an obstruction, and advised him to comply with the requirements
of the regulations regarding sunshades as soon as possible. Now
he informs me that he has had the structure removed altogether.

C. D. I.
O/C Special Branch.

C. D. I. Prince;
Please tell Mr Loh
to call personally on S. O. "B",
and give him the above
explanations. In the first
instance, Mr Loh should have
ascertained what was expected from
him and acted accordingly.
I have instructed Mr Loh
to comply as above.
19:9:32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号............
特别处 S. L. 分局，
报告
日期 1932年9月19日。
（全称） 关于“Loh Sik Kyi”，S. E. 违反市政规章事宜
由.................... 呈报 经.................... C.D.I. Prince 转呈。

先生，
1932年9月17日，我提请附属于特别处 S. L. 的 Loh Sik Kyi（陸爵）注意针对他的投诉，该投诉引自威格斯分局警司 J. Powell 所提交的附件报告，内容涉及其未遵守关于新闸路415号住所遮阳篷的指示。Loh Sik Kyi 告知我，自首次收到关于该遮阳篷的投诉以来，该遮阳篷一直未使用，他不明白还需要做什么。随后我向他指出，遮阳篷的支架构成了障碍物，并建议他尽快遵守有关遮阳篷的规章要求。现在他通知我，他已将整个结构拆除。

C. D. I.
特别处处长。

C. D. I. Prince；
请告诉 Loh 先生
亲自前往“B”区警司处，
并向其作出上述
解释。起初，Loh 先生本应
查明对他有何要求
并据此行事。
我已指示 Loh 先生
按上述要求办理。
1932年9月19日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No...........
REPORT
Station,
Date......OCTOBER 17, 1932.
A (in full).......Case of building violations.
Made by....I. Campbell.......Forwarded by Inspector C. Richardson
D. 1/c St B
Sir,
With reference attached, I beg to state that Von Gil-Kin, lic. no.,
of premises, 410 Sika Road, has so far failed to comply with
instructions contained therein relative to the erection of a sun-
shade to the required height situated in front of the said premises,
contrary to con; b of the amended permit, issued under ye-by 35.
Premises visited by D.I.Campbell at about 9 a.m., on Oct., 16.
Your obedient servant,
I. Campbell
D. I.
C. Div. "D".
S5,
For immediate attention
and report.
J.M.
17.9.32.
OFFICER I/C SP. DIV
AUG. 18 1932
C/1/c. S.
Check up that the complaint
is remedied and then file.
J.S.
19 AUG. 1932

由....I. Campbell 呈报.......经督察 C. Richardson 转呈
D. 1/c St B
先生，
关于附件所述事项，谨此陈述，Sika Road（音译）410号房屋的持证人 Von Gil-Kin（音译），执照号，至今未能遵守其中关于在上述房屋前搭建符合规定高度遮阳篷的指示，此举违反了根据第35条颁发的修订许可证的条件。副督察 Campbell 于10月16日上午9时左右视察了该房屋。

您顺从的仆人，
I. Campbell
副督察。
C. “D”区。
S5，

并报告。
J.M.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Special Branch S. 5. Station.
REPORT
Date August 13, 1932.
(full) Breach of Municipal Regulations by
Clerk Loh Sin-kyin attached to S. 5.
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Moore.

Sir,
With reference to the attached summons application and
memorandum from the Divisional Officer "B" Division, I have to
state that Clerk Loh Sin-kyin is at present absent from Shanghai
on leave.
The instructions of Divisional Officer "B" Division
have however been conveyed to the wife of the Clerk Loh, who has
promised to rectify matters immediately.

Moore
D. S. I.

O/C Special Branch. I
S. O. "B",
Information. Thank
you for stopping summons.
McEwen
OFFICER I/C SP. BR
AUG. 18 1932
II
C/Ie S.
Check up that the complaint
is remedied and then file.
Jioa
19 AUG. 1932

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号............
特别处 S. 5. 分局。
报告
日期 1932年8月13日。
（全称） 附属于 S. 5. 的职员 Loh Sin-kyin（音译）违反市政规章事宜
由副高级督察 Moore 呈报并转呈。

先生，
关于附件中的传票申请及“B”区分区警官的备忘录，我必须陈述，职员 Loh Sin-kyin 目前因休假不在上海。
然而，“B”区分区警官的指示已传达给职员 Loh 的妻子，她承诺立即整改此事。

Moore
副高级督察。

特别处处长。 I
“B”区警司，
知悉。感谢
停止签发传票。
McEwen
特别处主管警官
1932年8月18日
II
C/Ie S.
核查投诉是否已得到
纠正，然后归档。
Jioa（原文不清）
1932年8月19日
